solution.title: Synthetic Data Fidelity & Validation Asset Library

products.name: Synthetic Data Fidelity & Validation Asset Library — Commercial
products.short_description: Build a fidelity and validation asset library — statistical-fidelity/utility metrics vs real, coverage checks, and reusable validation assets — so every synthetic dataset ships with evidence of quality. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Prove your synthetic data is good enough — and reuse the proof

Synthetic data is only useful if it's faithful enough for the AI use case — and teams need reusable ways to prove it. This solution builds a fidelity and validation asset library: statistical-fidelity and utility metrics comparing synthetic to real, coverage/edge-case checks, and a library of reusable validation assets and test suites — so every synthetic dataset ships with evidence of quality and teams stop re-inventing validation.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run Python tooling.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the fidelity model: statistical fidelity vs utility vs privacy, coverage/edge cases, and the reusable-asset approach.
  • Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (reference statistics/governed real data, synthetic datasets, metrics, environment).
  • Implementation Guide — define the fidelity/utility metric suite, measure synthetic vs reference, build coverage/edge-case checks, and package reusable validation assets/test suites, pilot-first.
  • 5 Python tools — assessment/profiling, generation or scenario execution, a fidelity/coverage report, a privacy/validation check, and a scope/config helper — authentic to synthetic-data engineering (safe by default; no real PHI written to shared locations).
  • Testing/validation gates (fidelity within tolerance, coverage met, assets reusable) plus Best Practices for a growing validation library.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Every synthetic dataset shipped with evidence of quality — fidelity and utility measured, coverage checked, validation assets reused — so AI teams trust the data.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • Automation Scripts (ZIP) — 6 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • synfid_config.py — scaffold/validate a Validation Suite config, draft a Field Manifest, check mapping
    • synfid_coverage.py — check a synthetic dataset against a coverage / edge-case specification
    • synfid_fidelity.py — measure statistical fidelity (and optional utility gap) synthetic vs reference
    • synfid_privacy.py — report technical disclosure-risk SIGNALS on synthetic data (not a determination)
    • synfid_profile.py — build an aggregate-only Reference Profile from governed reference data
    • synfid_validate.py — run the full Validation Suite and emit a PASS/FAIL Evidence Report

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all Python scripts and tools in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
